purpose: Reclassify existing honeycomb evidence into floor anchors, saturation anchors, and lower-transition bands without collecting new data or rendering the legacy slope-only map.

posterior.likelihood: independent binomial logical-error counts at each measured distance

anchor_calibration.floor_event: all measured latent LERs are below epsilon
anchor_calibration.saturation_event: all measured latent LERs lie within delta of the binary-logical random limit 0.5
anchor_calibration.selection_rule: For floor and saturation separately, retain candidate tolerance/gate pairs that classify every validation anchor and no transition-exclusion cell; choose highest gate, then smallest tolerance. Fail closed if none qualify.
anchor_calibration.prior_stability_gate: Promote only anchors classified by the selected rule under both primary and sensitivity priors.

transition_band.scope: first lower decodable-to-undecodable transition as p increases at fixed q
transition_band.decodable_anchor: prior-stable floor anchor or prior-stable downward direction at the fixed 0.90 gate
transition_band.undecodable_anchor: prior-stable saturation anchor or prior-stable upward direction at the fixed 0.90 gate
transition_band.row_bracket: largest decodable-anchor p below the first higher undecodable-anchor p, paired with that undecodable p
transition_band.direction_applicability: direction evidence is presented only inside a valid row bracket
transition_band.boundary_uncertainty: report the discrete row bracket and width; later sampling value must target expected reduction of this width or boundary entropy, not gray-cell count

stop_rule: Stop after the no-new-data calibration and row-bracket analysis. Do not render a phase map, launch decoder jobs, or select new samples in the same transition.
claim_boundary: Operational finite-window anchor and lower-boundary-bracket analysis only; no continuous p_c interpolation, asymptotic threshold, or thermodynamic phase claim.
